plan.frames: All 61 usable observations in the frozen control-star bundle; one trial per level per observation.

position_shift_arcsec.direction: east in the ICRS tangent plane

plan.injection_method: Operate on per-trial copies of cached real cutout FITS. Use that frame EPSF array as the normalized PSF; preserve real background, flags, and variance arrays. For flux-change trials, add the specified fraction of the measured control-star aperture flux through the PSF, normalized to unit flux inside the same 3-pixel aperture. For position trials, subtract the PSF model fit to the measured source and add it at the specified eastward-shifted position. Do not alter the source case or the frozen bundle.
plan.detection_criterion: Use the unchanged source-extraction gates: local peak SNR >= 5, centroid associated within 5 pixels of the simulated predicted position, and frame passes the frozen quality/edge policy. Count a trial as recovered only if these gates pass and the relevant aperture flux or centroid is finite. This measures algorithmic source/measurement recovery, not statistical variability or motion significance.
plan.systematics_limit: Injection into real cutouts preserves some background/noise/flags but not the unknown cross-frame calibration and resampling systematics; it cannot establish real-world variability or motion sensitivity.

method: Use the frozen north-up IMAGE/ZODI/VARIANCE/FLAGS products. Sample the per-frame ePSF at native-pixel centers using the FITS OVSMPX/OVSMPY factors (5x), normalize it to the measured common-grid aperture flux, and inject only into in-memory copies. Run the same local SNR/centroid association and 3-pixel aperture photometry functions used by the real pipeline. The original files are read-only.
quality_gate: A trial is recovered when the source is detected at peak SNR >= 5, the local centroid is associated within 5 pixels of that trial's prediction, the frame is usable in the frozen case, and the measured flux/centroid is finite.
recovery_denominator: Completed attempted trials only. Missing frame inputs are marked attempted=false and recovered=null, are listed as unavailable, and are excluded from the recovery-rate denominator; processing errors are reported separately.

cannot_show: These injections are simulations on real image backgrounds. They retain some detector noise, sky background, flags, and resampling, but do not reproduce unknown cross-frame calibration, PSF, or correlated-resampling systematics. They cannot measure the real systematic floor or justify a motion/variability claim.
